verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents checkpoint-resume for durable tasks (docs-38, gh-1, docs-39), and docs-7 locks in-flight runs to their code version across deploys. Survival of crashes and deploys is explicitly claimed only for the AI-chat feature (docs-13). Otherwise the documented recovery mechanism is retries with exponential backoff (docs-4), and nothing shows a generic task resuming from its last completed step with state intact after a process or infrastructure failure. Community wish-list comments asking for wait/resume are old requests, not concrete failures, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of step-level resume after crash or infrastructure failure for general tasks, detail on how state is persisted, and independent hands-on corroboration of recovery.
